## Setting necessary variables


```{r}

# For execution on PC
setwd("I:/Dropbox/Programming/R/Wahl-O-Mat Korrelationen")
path <- "I:/Dropbox/Programming/R/Wahl-O-Mat Korrelationen"

```


## Importing Data downloaded from bpb-website


```{r}
# Importing database from excel file

temp <- read_xlsx(
  path = paste0(path, "/Wahl-O-Mat Sachsen-Anhalt 2026_Datensatz.xlsx"),
  sheet = 2
)

# Polishing tibble for R
  # Only keeping data necessary for determining correlation and visualization
db.parties <- temp %>% 
  select(`Partei: Kurzbezeichnung`, `These: Nr.`, `Position: Position`) %>% 
  rename(
    Partei = `Partei: Kurzbezeichnung`,
    These = `These: Nr.`,
    Position = `Position: Position`) %>% 
  mutate(
    Position = case_when(
      Position == "Stimme zu" ~ 1,
      Position == "Stimme nicht zu" ~ -1,
      Position == "Neutral" ~ 0
    )
  ) %>% # then reshaping the long format to a wide one
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Partei,
    values_from = Position
  ) %>% 
  select(!These)



  
```


## Correlation Matrix


```{r}

# Using Pearson Correlation and then reordering and filtering it
cormat <- as_tibble(round(cor(db.parties), 3)) 
cormat <- cormat %>% 
  mutate(Partei = colnames(.)) %>% 
  arrange(-`Die Linke`) # sorts with descending correlation to chosen party
cormat <- cormat%>% 
  select(Partei, cormat$Partei)




```



### Visualization of Correlations


```{r}

# Convert to long format for ggplot
cormat_long <- cormat %>%
  pivot_longer(-Partei, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Correlation")

# Ensure Partei and Variable follow the original order, but flip y-axis order
cormat_long <- cormat_long %>%
  mutate(
    Partei = factor(Partei, levels = rev(unique(cormat$Partei))),  # Flip y-axis order
    Variable = factor(Variable, levels = unique(cormat$Partei))  # Keep x-axis order unchanged
  )

# Plot heatmap
  plot1 <- ggplot(
    cormat_long, 
    aes(x = Variable, y = Partei, fill = Correlation)) +
    geom_tile(aes(fill = Correlation), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +  # Normal heatmap
    geom_tile(data = cormat_long %>% filter(Correlation == 1),  # Separate layer for r=1
              fill = "black", color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +  
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Correlation == 1, "", sprintf("%.1f", Correlation))), 
              color = "black", size = 3.5) +  # Hide text on diagonal
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "blue", high = "red", mid = "white", midpoint = 0,
      breaks = c(-1, 0, 1),  # Only show -1, 0, 1 explicitly
      labels = c("-1" = " -1  -  Gegensätzlich", "0" = "0  -  Keine Korrelation", "1" = "1  -  Ähnlich"),  
      limits = c(-1, 1),  
      guide = guide_colorbar(
        title.position = "top",
        label = TRUE,
        ticks = FALSE
      )
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),  
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),  
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),  
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key.height = unit(2.7, "cm"),  
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.position = "right"
    ) +
    labs(title = "Parteiähnlichkeit im Wahl-O-Mat") +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1.5)
  
  # Save the plot
  ggsave(filename = paste0(path, "/2026-LTW-SA-CorMap", ".png"), plot = plot1,
         height = 12,
         width = 9,
         bg = "white")

  
  
  
```


## Principal Component Analysis

```{r}

pca <- prcomp(
  scale(t(db.parties)), # Standardize the data
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE)

db.pca <- as_tibble(pca$x*-1) %>% 
  mutate(Partei = colnames(db.parties))

```


### 2D Visualization of PCA

```{r}

plot2 <- ggplot(db.pca, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = Partei)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(vjust = -1, size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +  # Vertical line at x = 0
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +  # Horizontal line at y = 0
  xlim(-7, 7) +  
  ylim(-7, 7) +  
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Hauptkomponentenanalyse der Parteien aufgrund der Wahl-O-Mat Antworten",
       x = "Hauptkomponente 1",
       y = "Hauptkomponente 2")

# Plot3: Scree Plot

temp <- pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2) * 100

plot3 <- ggplot(tibble(PC = seq_along(temp), Variance = temp),
                aes(x = PC, y = Variance)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Variance, 1)), vjust = -0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Scree Plot", x = "Hauptkomponente", y = "Erklärte Varianz (%)")


    # Saving the plots to a directory
  ggsave(filename = paste0(path, "/2026-LTW-SA-PCA", ".png"), plot = plot2 + plot3,
#         height = 12,
#         width = 9,
         bg = "white")



```


### 3D Visualization of PCA

```{r}

#options(rgl.useNULL = TRUE)

# For compatability purposes changing letters
db.pca <- db.pca %>%
  mutate(Partei_ascii = Partei %>%
    str_replace_all(c(
      "ä" = "ae", "ö" = "oe", "ü" = "ue",
      "Ä" = "AE", "Ö" = "OE", "Ü" = "UE",
      "ß" = "ss"
    ))
  )

# create 3D-Plot
plot3d(
  x = db.pca$PC1, 
  y = db.pca$PC2, 
  z = db.pca$PC3,
  col = "steelblue",
  size = 8,
  xlab = "Hauptkomponente 1", ylab = "Hauptkomponente 2", zlab = "Hauptkomponente 3"
)

# better clarity/visibility/spatial orientation
## reference plane at z = 0
planes3d(0, 0, 1, 0, alpha = 0.1, col = "grey")
## drop points from each point to z=0-plane
segments3d(
  x = rep(db.pca$PC1, each = 2),
  y = rep(db.pca$PC2, each = 2),
  z = as.vector(rbind(db.pca$PC3, 0)),  # from point down to z = 0
  col = "grey60"
)
## grid lines on back walls of box
grid3d(c("x", "y", "z"))
## box frame around the plot
#box3d()

# window size
par3d(windowRect = c(0, 0, 800, 800))

# add labels
text3d(
  x = db.pca$PC1, 
  y = db.pca$PC2, 
  z = db.pca$PC3, 
  texts = db.pca$Partei_ascii,
  adj = c(0.5, -1),
  cex = 0.8,
  depth_test = "always"
)

# zooming if wanted
par3d(zoom = 1.0)

# setting FOV (standard is 30)
par3d(FOV = 30)

# safe as rotating GIF
movie3d(
  movie = "2026-LTW-SA-PCA3D",
  spin3d(axis = c(0, 0, 1), rpm = 6),  # rotating around z axis (third component), rpm = spins per minute
  duration = 20,        # this implies 2 full spins with rpm = 6 
  dir = path,           
  type = "gif",
  fps = 25,
  webshot = FALSE
)


```
